title: An exact polynomial-time decider for renamable-Horn SAT
claims: RenamableHornSATInP proves membership in the pinned P class for the exact language of satisfiable CNFs that admit a Horn polarity renaming.
HornSATInP is the independently checked solver for exact Horn-SAT encodings.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
